# Extract Frame App

> Official site for the iPhone app "Video To Photo – Grab Frame" (App Store ID 6743497797): extract still photos (frames) from videos on iPhone, on-device.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://extractframeapp.com/): Product overview, screenshots, how it works, FAQ.
- [Guides](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/): Step-by-step iPhone guides, one per question.
- [Blog](https://extractframeapp.com/blog/): Longer articles on frame extraction and formats.
- [Privacy Policy](https://extractframeapp.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://extractframeapp.com/terms.html)
- [App Store Listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/video-to-photo-grab-frame/id6743497797)

## Guides

- [How to get a picture from a video on iPhone](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/how-to-get-a-picture-from-a-video-on-iphone/): The three ways to pull a photo out of a video on iPhone — and the only one that keeps full quality.
- [How to screenshot a video on iPhone without losing quality](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/screenshot-video-iphone-without-losing-quality/): Why video screenshots look soft — and the no-screenshot way to save a sharp, full-size frame.
- [How to save a frame from a video on iPhone](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/save-frame-from-video-iphone/): Export one exact frame from a video and put it in your Photos library or Files — without touching the original clip.
- [Frame grabber app for iPhone: how to pick the right one](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/frame-grabber-app-iphone/): Six things that separate a good video-to-photo app from a screenshot tool with ads — and a checklist to test any app in two minutes.
- [How to extract multiple frames from a video (on your iPhone)](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/extract-multiple-frames-from-video/): Grab a whole sequence of stills from one clip and export them together — as images, a ZIP archive or a PDF.
- [How to go frame by frame through a video on iPhone](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/frame-by-frame-video-iphone/): Find the precise moment in a video — and save it as a photo once you've found it.
- [How to get a clear, high-quality picture from a video](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/clear-high-quality-picture-from-video/): Why video stills look soft, what you can fix after recording, and what to change before you hit record.
- [Video to JPG, PNG or HEIC on iPhone](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/video-to-jpg-png-heic-iphone/): Which image format to pick for your video frames — and how to export them on iPhone without an online converter.
- [How to turn video frames into a PDF on iPhone](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/video-frames-to-pdf/): Pick the key moments of a video and export them as one clean PDF — for storyboards, lessons and reviews.
- [How to make a thumbnail from a video on iPhone](https://extractframeapp.com/guides/make-thumbnail-from-video-iphone/): Find the frame that earns the click, export it sharp, and turn it into a YouTube, TikTok or Reels cover.

- [Video frame to photo: iPhone లో ఫ్రేమ్‌ను ఫోటోగా సేవ్](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/video-frame-to-photo-iphone/): ఒక ఫ్రేమ్, పూర్తి రిజల్యూషన్, ఫోటోలు లేదా ఫైల్స్‌లో సేవ్.
- [iPhone video to photo app: ఎలా ఎంచుకోవాలి](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/video-to-photo-app/): మంచి యాప్ యొక్క ఆరు లక్షణాలు, 2 నిమిషాల చెక్‌లిస్ట్.
- [Video to photo frame capture: ఒకేసారి అనేక ఫోటోలు](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/video-to-photo-frame-capture/): ఒకేసారి అనేక ఫ్రేమ్‌లు, అవసరమైనవి మాత్రమే.
- [iPhone లో ఫ్రేమ్ బై ఫ్రేమ్ వీడియో: కచ్చితమైన క్షణం](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/frame-by-frame-video-iphone/): సరైన ఫ్రేమ్‌కు కచ్చితంగా చేరి దాన్ని సేవ్ చేయడం ఎలా.
- [Video to photo HD: iPhone లో ఫోటో ఎందుకు మసకబారుతుంది](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/video-to-photo-hd/): మసక, చీకటి, తక్కువ రిజల్యూషన్ ఫోటోలకు కారణాలు, పరిష్కారాలు.
- [Video to JPG, PNG, HEIC: iPhone లో ఫ్రేమ్ మార్పిడి](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/video-to-jpg-png/): ప్రతి ఫార్మాట్ దేనికి, ఫ్రేమ్‌లను ఎలా ఎక్స్‌పోర్ట్ చేయాలి.
- [Video to PDF: iPhone లో ఫ్రేమ్‌ల నుండి నోట్స్](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/video-to-pdf/): స్టోరీబోర్డ్, గైడ్ లేదా నోట్స్ ఒక PDF లో, నేరుగా వీడియో నుండి.
- [iPhone లో వీడియో నుండి YouTube థంబ్‌నెయిల్](https://extractframeapp.com/te/guides/youtube-thumbnail-from-video/): థంబ్‌నెయిల్ కోసం ఉత్తమ ఫ్రేమ్ ఎంచుకుని ఎక్స్‌పోర్ట్ చేయడం.

## Entity Definition

Video To Photo – Grab Frame is an iPhone frame grabber that turns video clips into high-resolution still photos entirely on the device. Users share a video from Photos, scrub to the exact moment, grab one or many frames and export them as JPG, PNG or HEIC — as separate files, a ZIP archive or a PDF. Sessions are saved as projects.

## Key Facts

- App Store ID: `6743497797`
- Subtitle: Extract stills, save offline
- Category: Photo & Video
- Platform: iPhone, requires iOS 18.6 or later
- Version: 1.2.2 (September 2026)
- Size: 24.9 MB
- App Store rating: 4.6 (12 ratings, US)
- Export formats: JPG, PNG, HEIC; containers: files, ZIP, PDF
- Processing: on-device, works offline, no account, no upload
- Pricing: free download with in-app purchases (weekly with free trial, annual, lifetime)
